 by Bob Maplewood at 2:30am on Sun 15th November 2026   (last updated 8:31pm 17/11/2026 )
 The spotlight is on Israel and Austria when they go toe-to-toe at Nagyerdei Stadion, for an exciting match on Tuesday. It is one of the many matches in the conclusive round of the Nations League B group phase with all the final pieces falling into place. Austria won 3-1 and 4-2 in the two most recent meetings with Israel, and go into their upcoming match with a psychological advantage.
 Israel head to their upcoming match as number 77 in the FIFA world ranking. Meanwhile, there is a pretty big gap to upcoming opponents Austria. They enter the game ranked number 22 in the world. 
 This is the final round of the group stage with Israel on three as number four and Austria on 11 as number one. 
 Israel are relatively average in the art of goal-scoring these days. They scored a steady 11 goals in their previous ten matches, for an average of 1.1 per game. They simultaneously allowed their opponents 13 goals, or an average of 1.3 a game. Furthermore, they fought their way to three clean sheets in this run. 
 Austria scored 23 goals, conceded nine and held on for a clean sheet in three of their last ten matches. 
 Israel vs Austria Prediction
 Israel Form
 Having collected three draws in their previous three matches, Israel are on the lookout for a win again. Against Kosovo it finished 0-0, before a draw with Ireland in a 1-1 match. In their latest match, they once again had to settle for a tie after drawing 0-0 against Kosovo. Israel just have a single win to show from their efforts in the past six internationals. They also drew three and lost two of these six encounters, in which they scored three and conceded seven goals.
 Austria Form 
 Austria have two draws and a win to show from their previous three matches. They started with a 2-2 draw with Ireland. This was followed by another draw with Kosovo, this time 1-1, before they outclassed Ireland by 1-0. Austria won three of a possible six internationals, as well as playing two draws and suffering one defeat. They scored ten while also conceding eight times. 
 Austria are on the look-out for a win, and we expect them to claim it in a high scoring match, when they visit Israel at Nagyerdei Stadion this coming Tuesday. 
 Austria didn't lose any of their 5 most recent games.

 Of the last seven encounters between Israel Austria over 2.5 goals came out one time. Odds on over 2.5 goals are at 3/5 with bookies. 
 Israel vs Austria Betting Tips
 Having scored just once lately for his country, Dor Peretz will be eager to hit the target again, and the upcoming game presents an opportunity to step up. Austria hope Sasa Kalajdzic can inflict some damage on their upcoming opponents by adding to his tally of two goals in his last six international matches.
 Israel won four of their previous 10 matches across all tournaments at Nagyerdei Stadion. They drew one and lost five as well, while Austria won three of their last 10 games away. They drew three and lost four. Goals are flowing freely for Israel on home soil currently, as both teams scored in six of their last 10 matches here. Both teams were also on target four times in Austria''s last 10 league games away from home. 
 Both teams to score was a winning bet seven times in the last seven encounters between these two rivals, while at least four goals happened five times. Israel managed an average of 2.13 goals, while Austria averaged 2.44 goals a game. Israel saw over 2.5 goals in five of their last ten matches across all tournaments, as they scored an average of 0.9 goals during this run. In the last ten games for Austria, six of them had more than 2.5 goals, and they scored an average of 1.7 times goals per game themselves.
